authored.title: كان بإمكاني أن
authored.explanation_ar: نصف إمكانية كانت متاحة في الماضي ولم تتحقق بالضرورة؛ قد تأتي مع إحساس بالفرصة الضائعة. لا تعني العبارة وحدها أن الفعل لم يقع دائمًا؛ وقد تدل على احتمال ماضٍ في سياقات أخرى. نركّز هنا على الفرص التي كانت متاحة.
authored.explanation_en: Use could have and a past participle for a past possibility or an action that was possible but may not have happened. Context matters: could have can also express a possible past event; this lesson mainly practices available but unused opportunities.
authored.contrast_ar: I could have helped قدرة أو فرصة؛ I should have helped حكم بأنه كان الأفضل أن أساعد.
authored.contrast_en: Could have need not express an obligation. Here examples mainly show unused opportunities; other contexts allow past possibility.

authored.form: By the time + past simple, past perfect clause
authored.title: بحلول الوقت الذي
authored.explanation_ar: يوضح ترتيب حدثين ماضيين: وقع حدث واكتمل الآخر قبله. ويشيع الماضي التام للحدث الأسبق.
authored.explanation_en: Use by the time with a past event to show that something else had already happened before it.
authored.contrast_ar: By the time we arrived, it had started ترتيب ماضٍ؛ When we arrived, it started تزامن أقرب.
authored.contrast_en: By the time plus a past event sets a reference point; past perfect identifies the earlier action in these examples.

options: By the time can set a past reference point; past perfect marks an action completed before it in this lesson.
By the time always means that both actions began at exactly the same instant.
Past perfect cannot occur with by the time.
